name: puppy-status
description: a status pane: the conversations that wait for you, the pipelines that need a look, one row for each other conversation, your rate limits and who holds codex, your scheduled jobs, and the finished conversations you may archive

notify.title: Notices
notify.description: on shows a short notice, while the status pane is open, when another conversation starts waiting for you; off shows none.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: on: each conversation writes a short file about itself into ~/.claude/puppy-status/ (this computer only) after every turn and while a question card waits, and the pane lists them. off: it writes nothing and the pane lists none.

push.title: Push
push.description: on: when a conversation stops to ask you something, send a push through the app's PushNotification tool, if your permission settings already allow it (no dialog is opened). side chats never push. off: none.

status_dir.title: Status folder
status_dir.description: Optional. A folder of pipeline-status files (FORMAT.md at the top of the repo). A pipeline that stopped on an error or went quiet shows on a 產線 card; one that is fine shows nothing. Empty: no such card. ~ is your home folder.

schedule_logs.title: Schedule logs
schedule_logs.description: Optional. A folder of scheduled jobs' logs (puppy-status/FORMAT.md, schedule logs). Each job shows on a 排程 card: its last run, and whether it worked. Empty: no such card. ~ is your home folder.

schedule_every.title: Schedule every
schedule_every.description: Optional. How often each job in the schedule logs should run, e.g. "daily 1d, weekly 7d" (m, h or d). A job that has not started for that long (and two hours more) says 該跑沒跑. A job not named here is never late, only failed or not.

paused.title: Paused
paused.description: Optional. Jobs (from the schedule logs) and pipelines (their "pipeline" id) you paused on purpose, e.g. "collector-tech-news, weekly". A paused job shows as 暫停中 in grey and is never late or failed; a paused pipeline is left off the 產線 card. Empty: none.
